answer: Each new identity must lock 3,000 spendable coins for four full epochs before its attestations count, and that lock is slashed if two keys share a funding path or recycle the same work hash. An answer becomes reward-eligible only when five established, non-kin peers independently echo the same attestation within the epoch window; a lone unsupported whisper from a fresh key is dropped and grants no seat. Under that rule, the nectar of extra grading seats costs more to counterfeit than to earn honestly.
